verdict.rationale: New Relic's service level management docs confirm you can define and consume SLIs and SLOs for applications. Its general alerting supports thresholds, anomaly detection and NRQL-based alerts. However, nothing in the pack mentions error budgets or burn-rate alerting tied to SLOs. missing for 10: evidence of error-budget tracking, SLO burn-rate alert conditions, depth beyond a single intro sentence on SLOs, independent or hands-on corroboration.
